standard_prerequisites: Perfect closure as a colimit of Frobenius towers; faithful flatness of Frobenius on F_p[T] via the free basis {1, T, ..., T^(p-1)}
Formal unramifiedness via vanishing of Omega (More on Morphisms, formally-unramified-differentials)

The cotangent complex distinguished triangle (Cotangent, section-triangle) and the naive cotangent criterion for formal smoothness (More on Morphisms, NL-formally-smooth; Cotangent, relation-with-naive-cotangent-complex)
core_obligations: F_A is faithfully flat with free basis {1, T, ..., T^{p-1}}, and A -> A_perf is a colimit of faithfully flat maps, hence faithfully flat
A_perf perfect means the relative Frobenius is a surjection, i.e. A_perf = A[A_perf^p], whence Omega_{A_perf/A} = 0 and A -> A_perf is formally unramified

The cotangent triangle with L_{A/F_p} = Omega_{A/F_p}[0] (A smooth over F_p) and L_{A_perf/F_p} = 0 (A_perf perfect) forces L_{A_perf/A} = Omega_{A/F_p} tensor A_perf [1], a free rank-1 module in degree -1, so A -> A_perf is not formally smooth, i.e. not formally etale
proof_roadmap: Faithful flatness via the Frobenius basis and colimits
Relative Frobenius surjective gives Omega = 0 and formal unramifiedness
Compute L_{A_perf/A} from the distinguished triangle and conclude non-formal-smoothness
